responsibility: Implements out-of-line behavior for Rust HIR path and generic-argument structures declared in `rust-hir-path.h`. It provides constructors, copy/assignment, cloning of nested type and expression arguments, and small path helpers for generic argument bindings, const generic arguments, expression paths, type paths, qualified paths, and path segments, preserving `Analysis::NodeMapping` and source locations for the reusable path vocabulary shared across expressions, patterns, types, and visibility restrictions.
same_name_distinction: Implements the path and generic-argument structures declared in `rust-hir-path.h`, including constructors, copy/assignment, deep-cloning of nested type and expression arguments, and helpers for expression, type, and qualified paths. Unlike the header, it supplies runtime behavior rather than the shared path data-model definitions.
